name: simplified-technical-english-rewrite
description: Rewrites a text in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Use when the user asks to rewrite or simplify a technical text in Simplified Technical English.

# Simplified Technical English rewrite

Rewrite the text in Simplified Technical English. Use simple words and short sentences.

test_case_results.source_text: To get started, you'll need to clone the repo and install the deps via npm. Make sure your env vars are set up correctly, e.g. the API key and the DB URL, otherwise the app won't be able to connect to the server and you might see a bunch of confusing errors in the console.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: To start, clone the repository and install the dependencies with npm. Make sure that the environment variables are set correctly, including the API key and database URL. If the variables are not set correctly, the application cannot connect to the server. The console can then show many errors.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the instructions, examples, condition, possible connection failure, and possible console errors from the source without adding facts.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: API, URL

test_case_results.source_text: The CLI caches the auth token in your home dir so that you don't have to log in every time you run a command, but if the token expires or is revoked by an admin you'll have to run the login command again to obtain a new one.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The command-line interface stores the authentication token in your home directory. You do not need to log in each time you run a command. If the token expires or an administrator revokes it, run the login command again to get a new token.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps all facts, conditions, and instructions from the source.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 3 times, with: your, You, you

test_case_results.source_text: Before opening a PR, please ensure that all unit tests pass locally and that the linter doesn't report any warnings, since the CI pipeline will reject any PR that fails either of these checks and a reviewer won't look at it until it's green.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Before you open a pull request, make sure that all unit tests pass locally and that the linter reports no warnings. The CI pipeline will reject the pull request if either check fails. A reviewer will not review the pull request until both checks pass.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all instructions, conditions, and consequences from the source without adding any facts.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: Before you open a pull request, make sure that all unit tests pass locally and that the linter reports no warnings.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: Config files are loaded in the following order: the global config in /etc, then the user config in your home dir, and finally the project config in the repo root, with each subsequent file overriding any values that were set by the previous ones.
test_case_results.rewritten_text:
The system loads configuration files in this order:

1. The global configuration file in `/etc`.
2. The user configuration file in the home directory.
3. The project configuration file in the project root.

Each later file replaces values set by an earlier file.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the loading order, file locations, and the rule that each later file overrides values from earlier files.

test_case_results.source_text: If the build fails with an out-of-memory error, you can try to increase the max heap size of the JVM via the JAVA_OPTS env var, although in most cases the real problem is a memory leak in one of the tests, which you should fix instead.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: If the build fails because of insufficient memory, you can increase the Java Virtual Machine maximum heap size with the `JAVA_OPTS` environment variable. However, the usual cause is a memory leak in one of the tests. Fix the memory leak instead.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the failure condition, memory setting, environment variable, likely cause, and instruction to fix the memory leak instead.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: If the build fails because of insufficient memory, you can increase the Java Virtual Machine maximum heap size with the CODEPLACEHOLDER environment variable.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The API returns a 429 status code when a client sends more than approx. 100 requests per min, and it's the client's responsibility to wait for the number of seconds given in the Retry-After header before it retries the request.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The API returns status code 429 if a client sends more than approximately 100 requests per minute. Before the client sends the request again, the client must wait for the number of seconds specified in the `Retry-After` header.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the status code, request limit, time period, and the client's required wait before retrying.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: Before the client sends the request again, the client must wait for the number of seconds specified in the CODEPLACEHOLDER header.
the rewrite uses refused words: approximately

test_case_results.source_text: We're deprecating the v1 endpoints in the next release, so all clients that still use them should migrate to v2 as soon as possible, because after the release the v1 endpoints will return an error and we won't provide any additional support for them.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The next release will deprecate the v1 endpoints. All clients that use v1 endpoints must migrate to v2 as soon as possible. After the release, v1 endpoints will return an error. We will not provide further support for v1 endpoints.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the deprecation timing, migration instruction, error result, and lack of support for v1 endpoints.

test_case_results.source_text: To restore a DB backup, stop the app first, then run the restore script with the path of the backup file as its only argument, and wait until the script prints "done" before you start the app again, since starting it earlier might corrupt the data.
test_case_results.rewritten_text:
To restore a database backup:

1. Stop the application.
2. Run the restore script. Use the backup file path as the only argument.
3. Wait until the script displays “done”.
4. Start the application.

Do not start the application before the script displays “done”. Starting the application too early can corrupt the data.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the required order, the script's only argument, the exact completion condition, and the warning that starting the application early can corrupt the data.

test_case_results.source_text: The UI doesn't update automatically when another user changes a task, so if two people are editing the same list at the same time, one of them might overwrite the other's changes without noticing it, which is a known issue that we plan to fix in Q3.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The user interface does not update automatically when another user changes a task. If two users edit the same list at the same time, one user can overwrite the other user's changes without knowing it. This is a known problem. We plan to fix the problem in the third quarter.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all facts, conditions, possibility, and timing from the source without adding information.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: If two users edit the same list at the same time, one user can overwrite the other user's changes without knowing it.

test_case_results.source_text: Logs are written to stdout in JSON format and are collected by the log agent that runs on each node, which forwards them to the central log server where they are kept for 30 days before they're deleted automatically.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The log agent on each node collects logs from standard output in JavaScript Object Notation format. The log agent sends the logs to the central log server. The central log server keeps the logs for 30 days and then deletes them automatically.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all facts, sequence, format, locations, and 30-day retention period from the source.

test_case_results.source_text: When you add a new dependency, pin it to an exact version in package.json rather than using a caret range, since an unexpected minor update of a third-party lib has broken our prod build twice in the last year.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: When you add a new dependency, use an exact version in `package.json`. Do not use a caret range. An unexpected minor update to a third-party library has broken the production build twice in the last year.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the instruction to pin new dependencies to an exact package.json version instead of a caret range and preserves the reason and all stated facts.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The search index is rebuilt every night at 2 a.m. UTC, which means that docs you publish during the day won't appear in the search results until the next morning, unless you trigger a manual rebuild from the admin page.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The search index is rebuilt every night at 2 a.m. UTC. Documents that you publish during the day do not appear in search results until the next morning. You can start a manual rebuild from the administrator page.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the timing, delay, and manual rebuild exception, with only wording and sentence structure changed.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: UTC, a.m.
the rewrite speaks to the reader 2 times, with: you, You

test_case_results.source_text: Numerous users have reported that the export feature is very slow for large projects, which is caused by the fact that it performs a separate DB query for every single task instead of loading all tasks with one query.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Many users report that export is very slow for large projects. Export makes one database query for each task instead of one query for all tasks.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps the reported slowness for large projects and the cause of one database query per task instead of one query for all tasks.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses refused words: very

test_case_results.source_text: If you'd like to contribute a translation, copy the English strings file, rename it with the code of your language, e.g. fr.json for French, and translate each value while leaving the keys unchanged, because the app uses the keys to find each string.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: To contribute a translation, copy the English strings file. Rename the copy with your language code, for example, `fr.json` for French. Translate each value, but do not change the keys. The app uses the keys to find each string.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps all instructions, conditions, examples, and the reason for leaving the keys unchanged.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: your

test_case_results.source_text: SSH access to the prod servers is restricted to members of the ops team, and all other engineers who need to inspect a server should ask the on-call engineer to perform the task for them or to grant them temporary access for a max of 4 hours.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: Only members of the operations team can use SSH to access the production servers. If another engineer needs to inspect a server, the engineer must ask the on-call engineer to do the task or to give temporary access for a maximum of 4 hours.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the access restriction, the required request to the on-call engineer, the two permitted options, and the maximum temporary access period of 4 hours.

rule_checks.failure_reason: 1 sentences have more than 20 words, such as: If another engineer needs to inspect a server, the engineer must ask the on-call engineer to do the task or to give temporary access for a maximum of 4 hours.
